name: cubecen
description: Deploy the app you are working on to Cubecen, fix failed deploys and live errors from the diagnosis, logs and metrics, and wire databases and domains.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy your app from GitHub and get a live URL
interface.longDescription: Deploy the repository you are working on to Cubecen and get a live URL. The agent checks the app is ready (port, start command, framework settings), creates the cube, waits for the release, wires a managed Postgres database, and reads the build and runtime logs to fix a failed deploy.
defaultPrompt: Why did my last Cubecen deploy fail?
Add a Postgres database to my Cubecen app.
